title: Removed the ReplicateData=false property
summary: Three Spend Request tables had an incorrectly applied ReplicateData property removed to restore proper data replication behavior.
key_points: Removed ReplicateData=false from three Spend Request tables (6840, 6841, 6845)
Restores correct data replication for these tables during cloud migrations
Added test coverage to prevent similar property misapplications in the future
quote: Removed wrongly applied "ReplicateData=false" property on tables.
